accepted.s: Under the backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh, what amount was provided per district per year?
accepted.x: The package provided Rs 50 crore per district per year.
accepted.tq: Use the exact figure and reject nearby amount traps.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the backward districts package of Andhra Pradesh:
1. It covered seven districts.
2. Four districts were from Rayalaseema.
3. Three districts were from North Coastal Andhra.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The package covered seven districts—four in Rayalaseema and three in North Coastal Andhra.
accepted.tq: Split the total into its regional components before selecting the coded option.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s: Which one of the following sets contains only the Rayalaseema districts covered under the backward districts package?
o: YSR Kadapa, Srikakulam, Anantapur and Vizianagaram
Anantapur, Kurnool, YSR Kadapa and Chittoor
accepted.x: The four Rayalaseema districts in the package were Anantapur, Kurnool, YSR Kadapa and Chittoor.
accepted.tq: Identify the regional grouping rather than relying only on the total number.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s: The total annual allocation under the backward districts package for the seven districts was approximately:
accepted.x: At Rs 50 crore per district for seven districts, the annual allocation was Rs 350 crore.
accepted.tq: Apply the simple multiplication of the per-district amount by the number of districts.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s: The Centre decided to continue support for Andhra Pradesh's backward districts. This decision relates primarily to which of the following?
o: Replacement of tax incentives by a corporate tax holiday
Transfer of all irrigation powers to the districts
Abolition of the special development package
Continuation of the backward districts package
accepted.x: The Centre decided to continue its support for Andhra Pradesh's backward districts under the package.
accepted.tq: Match the policy decision with its immediate subject.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s: The special packages for backward districts in Andhra Pradesh were modelled on which of the following?
o: Green Revolution and Golden Quadrilateral packages
Coastal Regulation and Smart Cities packages
accepted.x: The backward-district package drew upon the KBK (Koraput-Bolangir-Kalahandi) package of Odisha and the Bundelkhand special package.
accepted.tq: Expand the abbreviation and identify the paired models.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s: Which of the following best describes the adequacy issue concerning the backward districts package?
o: Initial allocations were made, but disbursements stalled.
Only North Coastal districts received the allocation.
The entire amount was released in the first year.
No allocation was ever made for the districts.
accepted.x: Initial allocations were made, but stalled disbursements slowed regional development.
accepted.tq: Distinguish between sanction or allocation and actual release.
accepted.sec: Backward districts package - amount per district per year, number of districts, continuation, model

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Sections 46(2) and 46(3) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014:
1. They provide for appropriate grants by the Centre.
2. They provide for a special development package.
3. They specify particular incentives for Rayalaseema and North Coastal Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Sections 46(2) and 46(3) provide for appropriate grants and a special development package, with particular incentives for Rayalaseema and North Coastal Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Check whether all three provisions belong to the same statutory subsection.
accepted.sec: Section 46(2) and 46(3) - grant provisions and adequacy of releases

accepted.s: The resource-gap grant provided to Andhra Pradesh for 2014–15 was:
accepted.x: The resource-gap grant for 2014–15 was Rs 3,979.50 crore.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among closely spaced numerical options.
accepted.sec: Section 46(2) and 46(3) - grant provisions and adequacy of releases

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states Andhra Pradesh's position regarding transfers after bifurcation?
o: The transfers exceeded all Finance Commission recommendations and the Prime Minister's assurances.
The transfers fell short of the Fourteenth and Fifteenth Finance Commission recommendations and the Prime Minister's assurances in the Rajya Sabha.
The transfers were limited only because the Thirteenth Finance Commission award was cancelled.
The State did not raise any issue concerning the adequacy of transfers.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh maintained that the transfers fell short of the Fourteenth and Fifteenth Finance Commission recommendations and the Prime Minister's assurances in the Rajya Sabha.
accepted.tq: Test the comparison between promised or recommended transfers and actual transfers.
accepted.sec: Section 46(2) and 46(3) - grant provisions and adequacy of releases

accepted.s: Section 94(1) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 envisages fiscal measures, including tax incentives, primarily to:
o: Determine the population ratio for grants
accepted.x: Section 94(1) directs the Centre to take fiscal measures, including tax incentives, to promote industrialisation.
accepted.tq: Link the statutory provision with its stated economic objective.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives under Section 94(1) - types notified and districts covered

accepted.s: Which combination correctly describes the tax incentives notified in 2015 for eligible new units?
accepted.x: The notified incentives were an additional depreciation of 35% and an investment allowance of 15%.
accepted.tq: Keep the two percentages attached to their correct incentive names.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives under Section 94(1) - types notified and districts covered

accepted.s: The tax incentives notified in 2015 applied to units set up during which period?
accepted.x: The incentives applied to units established between 1 April 2015 and 31 March 2020.
accepted.tq: Read both endpoints of the eligibility period; the starting year alone is insufficient.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives under Section 94(1) - types notified and districts covered

accepted.s: The tax incentives under Section 94(1) were applicable to eligible units established in:
o: Only the capital region of Andhra Pradesh
The notified backward districts of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
All districts of India without regional restriction
Only the coastal districts of Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The incentives applied to units set up in the notified backward districts of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
accepted.tq: Use the exact geographical coverage instead of the broader State name.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives under Section 94(1) - types notified and districts covered

accepted.s: Which of the following was criticised as falling short of the comprehensive package sought by Andhra Pradesh?
o: The creation of the KBK package
The division of the Thirteenth Finance Commission award
accepted.x: The tax incentives were criticised as insufficient compared with the comprehensive package sought by Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Find the policy measure that was considered inadequate rather than the statutory provision itself.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives under Section 94(1) - types notified and districts covered

accepted.s: Which statement is correct regarding the proposed corporate tax holiday and Special Category Status for Andhra Pradesh?
o: The corporate tax holiday was delayed, diluted or subsumed under GST, and SCS was denied.
The corporate tax holiday was replaced by a permanent 90% central share of CSS.
SCS was granted, but the tax incentives were withdrawn before 2015.
The promised 10-year corporate tax holiday was implemented immediately and SCS was granted.
accepted.x: The promised 10-year corporate tax holiday was delayed, diluted or subsumed under GST, while Special Category Status, including its 90% central share of CSS and tax exemptions, was denied.
accepted.tq: Separate the promised benefit from the benefit actually received.
accepted.sec: Tax incentives under Section 94(1) - types notified and districts covered

accepted.s: How many districts presently constitute Rayalaseema in the classification stated for its development issues?
accepted.x: Rayalaseema comprises eight districts: Kurnool, Nandyal, Anantapur, Sri Satya Sai, YSR, Annamayya, Tirupati and Chittoor.
accepted.tq: Count the complete district list rather than confusing it with the four package districts.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Rayalaseema has a low population density primarily because of:
o: Absence of Eastern Ghats hill tracts
accepted.x: Recurring droughts and famines are identified as major reasons for Rayalaseema's low population density.
accepted.tq: Match the regional demographic feature with its stated cause.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Which district has the highest groundwater withdrawal among the two districts specified?
accepted.x: Sri Sathya Sai has the higher specified groundwater withdrawal at 57.44%, compared with Chittoor at 55.16%.
accepted.tq: Compare both the district name and the associated percentage.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: The Godavari–Penna link, Phase I, is intended to transfer:
o: 73 TMC of Godavari flood water to the Pennar through a five-stage lift
71.5 TMC of Krishna water through a three-stage lift
3.283 lakh acres of irrigation water from the Krishna to Gundlakamma
24.20 TMC of Pennar water to the Godavari through a two-stage lift
accepted.x: Phase I of the Godavari–Penna link proposes to carry 73 TMC of Godavari flood water to the Pennar through a five-stage lift.
accepted.tq: Keep the source river, destination river, quantity and lift stages together.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Which project has been proposed to carry surplus Godavari water to Rayalaseema?
accepted.x: The Polavaram–Nallamala Sagar link has been proposed to carry surplus Godavari water to Rayalaseema.
accepted.tq: Identify the project by its stated source, destination and purpose.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Veligonda project:
1. It involves transfer from Krishna to Gundlakamma.
2. It was stated to be 71.5% complete.
3. Rs 768 crore was paid to 6,206 displaced families.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct regarding the Veligonda project and its rehabilitation payments.
accepted.tq: Verify the project route, completion percentage and rehabilitation figure independently.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Phase II of the Veligonda project is intended to add irrigation potential of:
accepted.x: Phase II of Veligonda is intended to add 3.283 lakh acres.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the irrigation-area figure from the project's completion percentage.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Handri Neeva Sujala Sravanthi is associated with the seasonal use of:
accepted.x: Handri Neeva Sujala Sravanthi is associated with the seasonal use of 24.20 TMC.
accepted.tq: Match the project name with its specific water quantity.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Rayalaseema's horticulture and micro-irrigation position:
1. It accounts for 43% of Andhra Pradesh's horticulture area.
2. It accounts for 52% of the State's horticulture output.
3. It accounts for 71% of the State's micro-irrigation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Rayalaseema accounts for 43% of Andhra Pradesh's horticulture area, 52% of its output and 71% of its micro-irrigation.
accepted.tq: Treat each percentage as a separate statement and check all three shares.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the distribution of districts in India's top ten for micro-irrigation?
o: Six Andhra Pradesh districts, including five from Rayalaseema and Prakasam
Six Andhra Pradesh districts, including all four package districts and two coastal districts
Seven Andhra Pradesh districts, all from North Coastal Andhra
Five Andhra Pradesh districts, all from Rayalaseema
accepted.x: Six Andhra Pradesh districts are among India's top ten for micro-irrigation: five from Rayalaseema and Prakasam.
accepted.tq: Check both the total count and the regional composition.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: Which of the following is identified as a consequence of industrial backwardness in Rayalaseema?
o: Rapid urbanisation and reduced drought frequency
Expansion of coastal manufacturing into every district
accepted.x: Rayalaseema lacks anchor industries, and this contributes to distress migration and an agrarian crisis.
accepted.tq: Trace the stated chain from industrial imbalance to social and agrarian outcomes.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: The Sri Bagh Pact, which promised Rayalaseema priority in irrigation for ten years, was concluded on:
accepted.x: The Sri Bagh Pact was concluded on 16 November 1937 and promised Rayalaseema irrigation priority for ten years.
accepted.tq: Use the exact historical date attached to the regional development promise.
accepted.sec: Rayalaseema development issues - drought, irrigation deficit, industrial backwardness

accepted.s: How many districts constitute Uttarandhra, also referred to as Kalinga Andhra, in the classification stated for its backwardness?
accepted.x: Uttarandhra or Kalinga Andhra comprises six districts.
accepted.tq: Count the named districts and distinguish the total from Rayalaseema's total.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct list of districts of Uttarandhra?
o: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Parvathipuram Manyam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam
Alluri Sitharama Raju, Eluru, Anakapalli, Kakinada, Visakhapatnam and Srikakulam
Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Prakasam, Nellore, Tirupati and Chittoor
Kurnool, Nandyal, Anantapur, Sri Satya Sai, YSR and Chittoor
accepted.x: The six Uttarandhra districts are Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Parvathipuram Manyam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam.
accepted.tq: Use elimination by checking every district in the regional list.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of tribal communities and areas is correctly matched?
o: Kotia and Porja — coastal Krishna delta
Khond and Jatapu — Bhogapuram urban area
accepted.x: Savara and Jatapu communities are associated with the Srikakulam side. Gadaba, Bagata, Kotia, Porja and Khond are associated with the Araku/Visakhapatnam agency.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure geographical pair and reject misplaced tribal groups.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: The tribal belt of Uttarandhra primarily comprises the:
accepted.x: The tribal belt of Uttarandhra lies in the Eastern Ghats hill tracts.
accepted.tq: Match the regional tribal belt with its physical setting.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: Which district has the lowest literacy among the indicators specified for Uttarandhra?
accepted.x: Alluri Sitharama Raju district has the lowest literacy among the specified indicators, at 44.67%.
accepted.tq: Link the lowest indicator with the correct district and percentage.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: The new Polavaram district, with headquarters at Rampachodavaram, was reported to have which combination of indicators?
o: Lowest literacy of 44.67% and density of 54
Lowest urbanisation of 2.84% and density of 54
accepted.x: The new Polavaram district, headquartered at Rampachodavaram, was reported to have urbanisation of 2.84% and population density of 54, both the lowest among the specified indicators.
accepted.tq: Keep the two indicators attached to the correct district and distinguish density from percentage.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: The lack of anchor industries in Srikakulam and Vizianagaram is associated with:
o: A decline in horticultural output across Rayalaseema
accepted.x: The absence of anchor industries in Srikakulam and Vizianagaram contributes to distress migration.
accepted.tq: Connect the industrial gap with its stated migration outcome.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: Vamsadhara Phase-II was reported to be approximately:
accepted.x: Vamsadhara Phase-II was reported to be 93.5% complete.
accepted.tq: Distinguish this completion percentage from the separate Veligonda figure.
accepted.sec: North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra) backwardness - tribal areas, migration, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram indicators

accepted.s: Which of the following is the planned link project associated with the Thotapalli barrage?
accepted.x: The planned project is the Nagavali–Suvarnamukhi–Vegavathi–Champavathi link via the Thotapalli barrage.
accepted.tq: Recall the full sequence of rivers in the named link project.

accepted.s: Bhogapuram airport is located in which district, with commercial operations targeted for June 2026?
accepted.x: Bhogapuram airport is located in Vizianagaram district, and commercial operations were targeted for June 2026.
